1.title: How Reddit’s designers build ultra-realistic prototypes with Figma + Cursor
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Reddit built Reddit Proto, an in-house prototyping harness that maps design system to production code via custom MCP; 700+ prototypes live; workflow: Figma annotation → Cursor edit → draft PR; real data instead of mocks; leadership review and handoff mechanics shown.

2.title: The New Full-Stack Designer
2.author: Y Combinator
2.hook: Shopify's design studio lead walks through his process on recent shipped work (admin redesign, Sidekick), a grass shader weekend project, and reviews five submitted websites focusing on motion, interactivity, and conversion patterns.
